mapper.sql: SELECT c.parent_agent_id::text, c.parent_release_version, c.child_agent_id::text, c.child_release_version, c.ordinal, c.required, c.created_at FROM cap_agent_child_ref c
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_agent_child_ref (parent_agent_id, parent_release_version, child_agent_id, child_release_version, ordinal, required, created_at) VALUES (#{parentAgentId}::uuid, #{parentReleaseVersion}, #{childAgentId}::uuid, #{childReleaseVersion}, #{ordinal}, #{required}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (parent_agent_id, parent_release_version, child_agent_id, child_release_version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WHERE c.parent_agent_id = #{parentAgentId}::uuid AND c.parent_release_version = #{parentReleaseVersion} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = c.parent_agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY c.ordinal ASC

WHERE c.parent_agent_id = #{parentAgentId}::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = c.parent_agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY c.parent_release_version ASC, c.ordinal ASC

WHERE c.child_agent_id = #{childAgentId}::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = c.parent_agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY c.parent_agent_id ASC, c.parent_release_version ASC, c.ordinal ASC
JOIN tenant_agent_binding b ON b.agent_id = c.parent_agent_id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.parent_agent_id ASC, c.parent_release_version ASC, c.ordinal ASC
